slot.brief: From a set of primary, secondary and tertiary amines, identify which respond to the carbylamine test and which do not.

stem: Which of the following amines give a positive carbylamine test: ethylamine, diethylamine, aniline and N,N-dimethylaniline?

verdicts.working: The carbylamine test is positive for primary amines only. Ethylamine and aniline are primary; diethylamine is secondary and N,N-dimethylaniline is tertiary.

working:
Carbylamine test is given only by primary amines.
Ethylamine and aniline are primary; diethylamine is secondary and N,N-dimethylaniline is tertiary.

Independent check: The carbylamine test is positive for primary amines only. Ethylamine and aniline are primary; diethylamine is secondary and N,N-dimethylaniline is tertiary.
solution: The carbylamine test is given only by primary amines. Ethylamine and aniline are primary, whereas diethylamine is secondary and N,N-dimethylaniline is tertiary; hence only ethylamine and aniline give the test.
